# Army Apolele

> A countdown for Greek military service. It calculates the days remaining until
> discharge, tracks leave, duties and money, and works offline. Built and
> maintained by Konstantinos Kotsaras.

Army Apolele encodes the Greek conscription framework that took effect on
1 January 2026 under Law 5265/2026: four intakes a year instead of six, all
conscripts serving in the Army, and a leave entitlement of three days for every
completed two-month period, capped at 36 days including sick leave. Pay is €50
a month, or €100 in a border unit.

The application is bilingual (Greek and English), installable as a PWA, and
local-first: without an account no data leaves the device. Signing in is optional
and exists only to sync a profile between devices.

The name comes from "απολελές και τρελελές", Greek army slang for a conscript in
the final stretch of service.

## Pages

- [Counter](https://army-apolele.web.app/): days until discharge, progress, days
  actually spent on base, pay earned, leave, duties and expenses
- [Install](https://army-apolele.web.app/install): how to add the app to a home
  screen on iOS, Android and desktop
- [Privacy](https://army-apolele.web.app/privacy): what is stored, what is not
  collected, and what optional sign-in changes

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/kotsarakos/ARMY-APOLELE): React 19, TypeScript,
  Vite. Domain logic in `src/lib/` has no React dependency.
- [Service rules](https://github.com/kotsarakos/ARMY-APOLELE/blob/main/src/lib/service.ts):
  every legal constant, named, in one file
- [Intake dates](https://github.com/kotsarakos/ARMY-APOLELE/blob/main/src/lib/esso.ts):
  confirmed and estimated call-up dates
- [Design system](https://github.com/kotsarakos/ARMY-APOLELE/blob/main/DESIGN.md)

## Notes for summarisation

- The discharge date is enlistment plus the months of obligation. Leave counts as
  service and never pushes it back; what leave changes is the number of days
  physically spent on base.
- Intake dates other than the 2026 A intake are estimates until each official
  call-up is published, and the app labels them as such.
- This is an independent, non-commercial tool. It is not affiliated with the
  Hellenic Army General Staff or the Ministry of National Defence, and an
  official discharge date is set by a conscript's own unit.
